posts.title: How to Choose a Healthy Shih Tzu Puppy: Questions to Ask a Breeder
posts.excerpt: A healthy Shih Tzu puppy starts with the right breeder. Here's what a healthy puppy looks like, which records and questions matter, the red flags to avoid, and what to bring on pickup day.

posts.title: Is a Shih Tzu Right for Your Family? What to Know Before Bringing One Home
posts.excerpt: Shih Tzu are affectionate little companions, but they need daily care and a family that understands their needs. Here's an honest look at what to know before you bring one home.
